title: docs: jobs.mdx should say install-local refuses a package with two enabled jobs of one name (follow-up of #32572)
body:
domain:server#7 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVSjQBHNkZd6Eqx2XX

Follow-up of #32572 (PR #32889). PR #32889 declares `Skills-docs: follow-up owed`: after it, the install-local door answers `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` for a package with two enabled jobs of one name (the refusal the binder already gives at bind), before any write. `content/docs/automation/jobs.mdx` does not say so; that file is outside the card's file surface.

## Owed

Add one sentence (with the refusal's remedy) to `content/docs/automation/jobs.mdx` where it explains job names, after PR #32889 lands. Copy the refusal text from the landed code; do not paraphrase the status or the code.

Restart-when: PR #32889 has merged.
